url.title: Url of the file
url.description: Publicly fetchable (or FileHaven) URL of the file to upload

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Name to give the file in Podio. Defaults to the URL basename. Include the extension so Podio detects the correct type.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: Content type of the file (e.g. application/pdf). Used to set the file extension when the filename has none.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description to set on the Podio file after upload.
